summary: Steep west kerb beside a motorway, with houses 11-13 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Houses 12-23 m on the kerb side and 15-25 m across the road; gardens, no bush or park cover.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street with marked lanes; cars park on both sides.
drivers.traffic: Motorway close to the east and a busy junction at the top.
drivers.convention: Residents park along the street; no sign of van-dwelling.

flags: Steep: about 12.4% mean grade, at the 12% limit
sun_shade: Open kerb; garden trees give some afternoon shade from the west.

best_section.where: west kerb mid-slope, by the red-roofed house
